title: Financing Paperwork on Changes to Financed Window Contracts
content:
# Financing Paperwork on Changes to Financed Window Contracts

Window Replacement Contracts — rate applied to change-order fees on contracts paid through Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing.

**Rule.** The contract's financing plan is the plan of its Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account in force (approved, active, delinquent or paid off); a cancelled or charged-off account is never read. The change-order fee is multiplied by a lender paperwork share: a contract paid by Ridgeline financing whose financing plan carries a promotional period takes the promotional-plan share of 1.5; a contract paid by Ridgeline financing on a plan without a promotional period takes the term-plan share of 1.25; any other contract, whether paid by cash, check or card or carrying no financing plan on record, takes a share of one.

The payment method is the one on the window contract; the promotional period is the promotional months of the financing account's plan. The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

| Contract payment method | Financing account in force on the contract | Plan promotional period | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline financing | Yes | One or more promotional months | 1.5 |
| Ridgeline financing | Yes | None | 1.25 |
| Ridgeline financing | No account in force | — | 1 |
| Cash, check or card | — | — | 1 |

## Hypothetical readings

- A financed contract whose only financing account is charged off: no plan is read, share 1.
- A financed contract on a plan with a 12-month promotion, account delinquent: share 1.5.
